sources.label: o0b
sources.author: o0b
patch_list: No-ops Bugsnag on Nova Launcher 8.1.6: both HTTP deliverers return DELIVERED so no payload ever leaves the device (queued error files are deleted as sent), and Nova's error-reporting flag is forced false — which also disables novalytics us…

Disables Nova Launcher 8.1.6's Sesame third-party integrations (Spotify, OneDrive, Twitch, Slack, Discord, Dropbox, Deezer, GitHub): the integration ingest always returns 0 items, so no background or manual data pulls run and their APIs ar…
Removes the bundled Sesame (Branch) deep-shortcut results from Nova Launcher's search on 8.1.6 by no-op'ing its results provider. Search still returns apps, contacts and settings.
Unlocks Nova Launcher Prime on 8.1.6 by forcing the runtime prime flags (Lzg/t1;->y / ->t) to true at every write — the settings initializer and the Prime-unlocker package-change handler.
